problem: Add search over 10 million product descriptions, returning results in under 100 ms
context: Data lives in PostgreSQL 15. Queries are keyword searches typed by users.
constraints: Must not add new infrastructure or third-party services
p95 search latency must stay under 100 ms

options.summary: Deploy an Elasticsearch cluster and index the descriptions
Send the descriptions to Algolia and query its hosted search API
Query with WHERE description ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' and no index

criteria.description: Returns relevant results for keyword queries

expected.why: The first two break the no-new-infrastructure rule; an unindexed ILIKE scan of 10M rows can't meet 100 ms. The right answer (Postgres full-text search) isn't listed.
